title: FOMO samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the FOMO pipeline samplesheet

species.errorMessage: Species name must be a non-empty string with no spaces

role.errorMessage: Role must be 'source' (donor only), 'target' (annotated only, no gff3), or 'both' (donor and target — the all-vs-all case)

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file must exist and end in .fa, .fasta, or .fna (optionally .gz)

gff3.errorMessage: GFF3 file must exist and end in .gff or .gff3 (optionally .gz)

then.errorMessage: A row with role 'source' or 'both' donates its annotation and MUST have a gff3. Only a pure 'target' leaves it empty — it is then annotated but not benchmarked (no gffcompare, no top-N consensus).

A row with role 'target' must leave gff3 empty: a target is only projected onto. To also benchmark it against its own annotation, use role 'both' — note that this makes it a donor to every other target too.
